The campus-budget-at-risk-calc implementation achieved a perfect verifier reward by passing all legacy pytest suites.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.73, with zero exceptions across all trials. The pytest tool (version 8.4.1) confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the logic is reusable, the discrepancy between verifier and judge rewards suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling.
